== Summary ==
Historical full-card composite of [[Darth Vader (V) (Virtual Set 1) (Errata 2)|Darth Vader from Original Virtual Set 1]], distributed in the [[Holotable]] large-image package through Virtual Set 17. The original composite is retained unchanged, including the different frame/slip presentation and printed lower number 10. The matching [[:File:VS1O-10-Darth_Vader.png|later publisher slip]] prints number 10.
